questions.name: Payment punctuality over time · due month
questions.description: One charge is one obligation. On time means both principal and interest fully covered by its due date. Partial payments are combined. Due dates today/future, zero/accounting obligations and invalid evidence are excluded. A late settlement stays late. Historical timing uses effective payment dates; current outstanding includes today. No eligible history means unavailable, never 100%.
